title: googledrive source
description: Polls a Google Drive folder and produces a message for every file. The body is the file content; the headers are file.name and googledrive.id. Subfolders and Google's own formats (Docs, Sheets, ...) are skipped. A consumed file is moved to the subfolder moveTo of the folder, which is created if needed. A failed poll is logged and tried again.

path.title: Folder id
path.description: Id of the Drive folder, from the URI (googledrive:<folderId>)

accessToken.title: Access token
accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token; @{name} is replaced by the tenant variable name (see oauth2token)

filterFiles.title: File name
filterFiles.description: Only consume files with exactly this name

moveTo.title: Move to
moveTo.description: Subfolder a consumed file is moved to

gSuiteFiles.title: Google formats
gSuiteFiles.description: What to do with Docs, Sheets and the like; Ignore is the only choice

tenant.title: Tenant
tenant.description: Tenant of the variables in accessToken

flowId.title: Flow id
flowId.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds one call to Drive may take
